international.title: Anthropic shares slump on second day of trading as markets reel from AI sell-off
international.summary: Asian markets record worst week since 2020 as investors question huge sums being poured into AI build-out Business live – latest updates Anthropic’s shares have slumped at the start of a second day of trading, as its record-breaking IPO failed to stem a sell-off in AI-linked companies. Shares in the frontier AI company, which floated on Thursday, fell by as much as 12% on Friday. They dropped to $85.12, towards the $83 level at which Anthropic priced its stock market debut.
